title: Generator Work Order Form
subtitle: An original generator workflow that controls authorized field work from dispatch through return to service, with explicit qualified-review, stop-work, escalation, and accountable handoff controls.
description: A workflow-complete generator work order form for the standby or prime generator system that captures exact identity, domain observations, supporting evidence, decisions, exceptions, responsible owners, and closeout without replacing professional judgment or the organization's controlling procedures.
use_case: Use when a qualified crew receives a defined task and must preserve asset identity, work limits, energy-control references, as-found evidence, work performed, testing, exceptions, and operations handoff. The generator service coordinator owns routing, and closure requires documented evidence, disposition of restrictions, and acceptance by the designated reviewer.

sections.title: Generator work order identity and dispatch
sections.guidance: Issue a traceable order with clear ownership, site contacts, and approved work limits.

sections.title: Generator asset context, scope, and resources
sections.guidance: Match the order to the exact standby or prime generator system and define work that is included and excluded.

blocks.label: Authorized task scope
items: Confirm generator, engine, controller, battery, fuel, and ATS identities
Coordinate affected loads, outage limits, and run or transfer authorization
Establish hazardous-energy, start-prevention, exhaust, and access controls
Inspect fuel, lubrication, cooling, intake, exhaust, battery, and charging systems
Complete approved filters, fluids, belts, hoses, terminals, or cleaning work
Record controller alarms, hours, settings, and maintenance indicators
Perform authorized start, run, load, and transfer checks
Record oil pressure, temperature, voltage, frequency, load, and battery values
Correct labels, housekeeping, leaks, and deficiencies within approved scope
Return unit to approved mode and hand off limitations to the site owner

blocks.label: Scope, exclusions, parts, and completion criteria

fields.label: Approved work, explicit exclusions, required parts or tools, evidence expected, and completion criteria

sections.title: Generator pre-work controls and authorization
sections.guidance: Do not begin intrusive work until hazards, system effects, isolation ownership, and test authority are explicit.

blocks.label: Pre-work authorization confirmations
items: Exact asset, boundaries, sources, and affected systems were identified
Site-specific procedure and applicable requirements were reviewed
Authorized and affected people, roles, and communications were confirmed
Electrical, mechanical, pressure, thermal, chemical, gravity, and stored energy were assessed
Isolation devices and personal or group controls remain under designated ownership
Stored or residual energy was controlled and verification evidence was recorded
Test or temporary re-energization steps and authority are explicit
Public, customer, traffic, environmental, and critical-load controls are in place

blocks.label: Energy-control and qualified-person boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not a generator energy-control, energized-work, or transfer authorization. Stop for fuel leaks, exhaust or carbon-monoxide concerns, fire, heat, arcing, unexpected start, exposed moving parts, or unknown backfeed. Qualified and authorized personnel must control isolation, test conditions, affected loads, and return to automatic service under current site procedures. This work order records references and decisions; it does not replace the site's energy-control procedure. Unknown, changed, or reaccumulating energy is a stop condition until the designated authorized person re-establishes and verifies control.

sections.title: Generator work execution and test evidence
sections.guidance: Record what was actually done, by whom, against which task, and with what result.

blocks.label: As-left readings and test results
blocks.guidance: Record method, instrument, operating state, and acceptance reference in linked evidence when needed.

fields.label: Unexpected conditions, approved changes, temporary measures, test context, and evidence links

sections.title: Generator exceptions, stop conditions, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make every unresolved condition visible with an immediate control, owner, due point, and final disposition.

blocks.label: Stop-condition screen
items: Fuel, oil, coolant, exhaust, or battery leak
Carbon-monoxide alarm, exhaust intrusion, or ventilation failure
Smoke, fire, abnormal heat, burning odor, or electrical arcing
Unexpected start, automatic operation, transfer, or backfeed risk
Exposed moving part, damaged guard, severe vibration, or loose component
Uncontrolled stored electrical, mechanical, thermal, or fluid energy
Critical-load interruption without site and operations authorization
Test or repair beyond the assigned qualified person's scope
blocks.guidance: Check any condition observed or reported; checking an item does not mean the condition is controlled.

blocks.label: Qualified-person and stop-work boundary
blocks.guidance: This form is not a generator energy-control, energized-work, or transfer authorization. Stop for fuel leaks, exhaust or carbon-monoxide concerns, fire, heat, arcing, unexpected start, exposed moving parts, or unknown backfeed. Qualified and authorized personnel must control isolation, test conditions, affected loads, and return to automatic service under current site procedures.

blocks.label: Exception and escalation register
blocks.guidance: Link each work order exception to supporting evidence and keep it open until disposition is recorded.

sections.title: Generator decision, handoff, and accountable closeout
sections.guidance: Record the decision, remaining limitations, next action, and the people accountable for acceptance.

blocks.label: Closeout completeness
items: Standby or prime generator system identity and location were reconciled
Observed facts, measurements, and evidence references are complete
Decision authority and applicable review requirements were confirmed
Stop conditions, restrictions, and open exceptions remain visible
Customer, operations, or site handoff was recorded
Next action, owner, due point, and record-retention route are explicit

fields.label: Limitations, assumptions, restrictions, customer message, and next-action context

blocks.label: Accountable review and handoff
blocks.guidance: Signatures acknowledge the recorded decision and handoff; they do not waive unresolved restrictions.
